cases.causal_failure_excerpt:

a zombie leader alone cannot release group ownership

cases.patch:
diff --git a/crates/rrx/src/adapter/inspection.rs b/crates/rrx/src/adapter/inspection.rs
index e6a5eea..fef7f0e 100644
--- a/crates/rrx/src/adapter/inspection.rs
+++ b/crates/rrx/src/adapter/inspection.rs
@@ -204,7 +204,7 @@ fn inspect_command(
     let child = command
         // Order matters in the legacy negative control; production env_clear
         // leaves UNIX2003 enabled. -G is a real group, not a process group.
-        .args(["-g", &leader.to_string(), "-o", "pid=,pgid=,stat="])
+        .args(["-p", &leader.to_string(), "-o", "pid=,pgid=,stat="])
         .env_clear()
         .stdin(Stdio::null())
         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
